Hi Priya / Sam —

Thanks for the introductory call earlier. To keep momentum we want to align on two parallel tracks for GCP marketplace onboarding: (1) SKU/inventory mapping so the listing shows correct billing units and (2) procurement/contract handshake so your procurement team can issue a PO quickly once listing pricing is live.

I attached a starter inventory spreadsheet (gcp_listing_inventory.xlsx) with suggested SKUs, unit types, and estimated monthly volumes based on your usage notes. Can you: 
- Confirm the usage columns (dev vs prod) by EOD Wednesday
- Identify your procurement contact who will sign the PO/terms (name + email)

Internal ask: Marissa — can you review the SKU naming and pricing bands and flag anything that needs Marketplace product review? Jonas — please flag any technical listing constraints (min units, billing cadence) we should surface to Helio. Vanessa — I'll need a quick checklist for procurement handoff (PO templates, required legal clauses).

Attachments: gcp_listing_inventory.xlsx

Best,
Irene

Looping in pricing and ops notes. Quick review:
- SKU names in the spreadsheet mostly fine; suggest standardizing units to "instance-hours" for compute and "embedding-units" for embedding calls.
- Pricing bands: propose a 10% dev discount tier for less than 5k units/month to keep initial switch friction low.
- Billing cadence: GCP marketplace supports monthly invoicing with monthly usage export — no upfront commitment needed for the listing itself.

I'll take the attached and update column F with suggested SKU slugs by EOD.

Also attached: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (internal MAP we use to track milestones + owners).

Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing — inventory mapping & procurement handshake

Thanks — quick technical notes from the runtime/listing side before we lock SKUs:
- Minimum billable increment: 1 instance-hour. If Helio wants per-1000-embedding pricing we need to expose an aggregated usage metric; the spreadsheet approach works but we should map which API calls map to each SKU.
- Caching/burst credits: we can set an initial free-burst allowance for the first 30 days to help trial conversions — recommend we discuss that in the MAP.
- Marketplace metadata: ensure the product descriptor includes supported architectures and an approximate latency SLA. GCP will display these, and some buyers use them to filter.

I attached a short security summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) for procurement intake — Irene, pass this to Camille.

Jonas Weber
Lead, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf

Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing — inventory mapping & procurement handshake

Hi all — Camille here (procurement at Helio). Thanks for the files — they look good. A couple of procurement items to keep the listing activation moving:

- PO/Order Form: please send your standard Order Form template. Our legal is fine with a PO + Order Form flow; we only escalate MSAs for enterprise commitments.
- SOC 2 summary received, good to attach to vendor intake.
- Billing: we bill monthly net 30; please confirm Redwood accepts net-30 on marketplace invoices.
- Tax: Helio requires W-9 for vendor setup — can someone from finance provide the form or a contact?

If you can send the Order Form template and confirm net-30 by tomorrow, I can route a PO the same week.

Thanks,
Camille Rivera
Procurement Lead
